mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_log WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND action = 'ENTRY' AND result = 'PASS' AND id NOT IN ( SELECT al_entry.id FROM access_log al_entry INNER JOIN access_log al_exit ON al_entry.appointment_id = al_exit.appointment_id AND al_exit.action = 'EXIT' AND al_exit.result = 'PASS' AND al_exit.created_at > al_entry.created_at WHERE al_entry.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND al_entry.action = 'ENTRY' AND al_entry.result = 'PASS' )
